Run manifest and health
/app/run.json holds string install, build and serve commands with "_schema":"run-manifest-v1", the server listens on 0.0.0.0 at port 4173 or APP_PUBLIC_PORT, and GET /api/health answers as stated in Deployment.

Grading setup route
POST /api/grading/setup with the right grading key creates confirmed people, nested outlines, copies and shares and returns their ids by ref, and any other key gets the published 404.

One error order
Every API route applies the single error order, bodies, content type rule and size limits stated in Server boundary, and never answers 403.

Marketing page
The signed-out home page shows the outline top bar, the branching dot-field canvas hero, the outline pane window demo and every section listed in Screens and layout, with Pellwick & Ash's own copy.

Hero demo motion
The hero's outline pane window types the community garden list, the Nest it pill regroups it with children sliding in one after another, and reduced motion shows the finished list and swaps instantly.

Outline screen look
The signed-in outline is one centred outline pane window of compact Inter bullet rows with a fixed indent per level and grey chips, and the sky accent appears only on pills, focus rings and the active view.

Three viewports
At 375x812, 768x1024 and 1280x800 the marketing page, sign-up, outline, board, Share bullet dialog and not-found page show no horizontal overflow.

Live sync pause and catch-up
When live fan-out stops for the pause window, the outline shows the published paused banner while edits keep saving, and a reconnecting tab gets every missed change once and in order, or reloads its branch with the published notice, as qualified in Business rules.

Configuration from environment
Every service URL, credential, timer, limit and the grading key is read from the environment at start and is never hard-coded or sent to the browser.

Sign-up confirmed by emailed code
A new person signs up, the page confirms the code was sent only after Mailpit accepted it, and entering the 6-digit code from the Mailpit message opens an empty outline with the published empty copy.

Same reply for taken addresses
Signing up with an address that already has an account gives the same status, body and on-screen copy as a new address, and Mailpit receives exactly one message either way.

Keyboard outline building
A person builds a three-level outline using only Enter, Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys and typing, the focused bullet always shows a visible focus ring, and the outline is identical after reload.

Published tree attributes
Every bullet row is a treeitem named by its text that carries aria-level, aria-expanded, aria-selected, data-bullet-id, data-depth, data-collapsed, data-completed and data-mirror-of exactly as defined in Public screens and controls.

Backspace on an empty bullet
Backspace in an empty bullet without children deletes it and puts the caret at the end of the bullet above, and in an empty bullet with children it deletes nothing and shows the published refusal.

Moving with children
Ctrl+ArrowUp and Ctrl+ArrowDown move the focused bullet with its children one place, crossing into the neighbouring parent at the edges as qualified in Business rules, and announce the new position.

Move refusals at the ends
Moving the first bullet of the view up or the last bullet down is refused with the published alert copy and leaves the server tree unchanged, and the API answers 409 where the tree decides it, as qualified in Business rules.

Moves in a second tab
A move made in one tab appears in the same person's second tab, in the new order, within two seconds and without reload.

Indent and outdent
Tab makes the bullet the last child of the bullet above, and Shift+Tab places it right after its old parent while its later siblings stay under the old parent, each with the published announcement.

Indent and outdent refusals
Indenting a bullet with no bullet above it at its level, indenting past the depth limit, and outdenting a top-level bullet of the current view are refused with the published alert copy and leave the server tree unchanged.

Deleting a bullet with children
Deleting a bullet that has children opens the Delete bullet dialog naming how many bullets are inside, Delete moves the whole branch to the trash, and Cancel or Escape keeps it and returns focus to the bullet.

Collapse and expand
Ctrl+Space or the disclosure button hides and shows a bullet's children, updates aria-expanded and data-collapsed, animates in under a quarter second, and survives reload.

Branch focus zoom
Alt+ArrowRight or the bullet dot zooms into a bullet so the URL becomes /b/<id>, its text becomes the page title and the breadcrumb gains a crumb, and Alt+ArrowLeft or a breadcrumb link zooms out with focus back on the zoomed bullet.

Zoom motion and reduced motion
Zooming moves the bullet's text into the title in under a quarter second, fades children in one after another and reverses on zoom out, and with reduced motion it swaps in one frame with the same focus, URL and announcement.

Empty and not-found branches
A view with no bullets shows the published empty copy and pill, and /b/<id> for an id the person cannot open answers 404 with the published not-found page.

Completing bullets
Ctrl+Enter or the Complete button toggles completion with the published look and announcement, sets data-completed, and leaves the bullet's children unchanged.

Hide completed
The Hide completed switch hides completed bullets with their children, announces the published hidden count, stays on for the person across reloads, and shows completions made in another tab within two seconds.

Mirroring a bullet
Ctrl+Shift+M or the Mirror button places a copy of the focused bullet directly below it, carrying data-mirror-of and the original's text, completion, tags and children.

Edits reach every copy
Editing text, completion or tags in any placement updates every placement, in every open tab of every person who can see it, within two seconds and without reload.

No mirror inside itself
Placing a bullet or a copy anywhere inside itself, directly or through a copy, is refused with a 409 and the published alert copy, and the tree is unchanged.

Deleting copies and originals
Deleting a copy removes only that placement, and deleting an original moves it to the trash while every copy, in every tab, shows the published placeholder.

Restoring by undo
Undo inside the trash window brings back a deleted branch with the same ids, depths, order, completion, tags, dates and copies, and every copy shows the text again.

Purge after the trash window
Once the trash window has passed, a trashed bullet answers 404, is absent from search, suggestions and downloads, can no longer be restored, and its copies keep the placeholder.

Search operators
Search combines words, quoted phrases, #tag, @person, is:complete, has:date and minus exclusions with AND, exactly as the worked examples in Business rules show.

Live filtering with a count
Typing in Search outline filters the open view in place after a short pause, shows ancestors as context, announces the published match count, and clearing the search restores the outline.

Dates in bullets
A date written as !(<date>) in a published format becomes the bullet's date and shows as a chip in the one display format, with today and tomorrow taken from OUTLINE_TODAY.

Tag and mention suggestions
Typing # or @ in a bullet opens a Suggestions listbox of the tags or mentions in the person's view, most used first, and Enter inserts the highlighted one.

Board layout
Show as board shows the view's children as columns named by their text with a card count and their children as cards, and Show as list returns to the same tree.

Moving cards
A card moves within and between columns by pointer drag and by Space, arrow keys and Space with the published announcements, Escape cancels, and the move appears in a second tab.

Branch invitations
Inviting an email address onto a bullet answers the same for known and unknown addresses, reads Sent only after Mailpit accepted the invitation, and stays Not sent with a Retry button when mail is down.

Working in a shared branch
An invited collaborator accepts from the Mailpit link, lands on the shared bullet as the top of their view, and edits it and everything inside it with every keyboard and touch control.

Nothing outside the shared branch
For a collaborator, every id outside the shared branch answers the published 404 and not-found page, and search, suggestions, board counts, downloads and live updates cover only the branch.

Removing access
Removing a share ends the collaborator's access at once, so their next request answers 404 and their open tab shows the published notice.

Live co-editing
An owner and a collaborator editing the same branch in two browsers see each other's text, moves and completions in place within two seconds, without reload.

Stale saves refused
A save based on an older revision answers 409 with the current text, exactly one of several simultaneous saves of one revision wins, and the losing tab shows the winning text and the published conflict notice.

Simultaneous moves
Moves apply in arrival order against the current tree, so of two moves that together would nest bullets inside each other the second is refused, and every tab settles on one tree.

Undo and redo across tabs
Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Shift+Z and the Undo and Redo buttons take back and reapply the person's own last change as one announced step, and the result appears in their other tabs.

Exact undo of structure
Undoing a move, indent, outdent or delete returns every affected bullet to its exact old parent and position with the same ids.

Undo limits
History keeps the configured number of steps per person, undo past it shows the published refusal, a later change by another person is never reverted, and a new change clears redo.

Phone toolbar editing
At 375x812 with touch, the Bullet actions toolbar's buttons perform every keyboard action on the focused bullet with the same server result and announcements.

Touch gestures and targets
On a touch screen, a swipe right on a row indents, a swipe left outdents, a tap on the dot zooms, every control listed under Touch in Interactions is at least 44 by 44 pixels, and each row is at least 44 pixels tall.

Downloads
Plain text, Markdown and OPML downloads of the current view reproduce depth, order, completion, tags, mentions, dates and copies in the published formats.
/app/run.json exists with string install, build and serve fields and "_schema":"run-manifest-v1", and nothing else is needed to start the app.

THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md at /app lists every shipped package and every bundled font and icon set with its licence. Shipped packages are the production dependency tree from npm ls --omit=dev --all --json.
Every shipped package, font and icon is under MIT, ISC, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, Apache-2.0, 0BSD or OFL-1.1.

The app stores data only in the provided Postgres and Valkey and sends mail only through the provided Mailpit. There is no SQLite, no file-based data store, and no other database, queue or cache service.
package-lock.json is committed, and pages load no fonts, scripts or styles from any CDN or external origin.
The provided service compose files and their seeded credentials are left unchanged.
